name: Nonviolent Resistance
description: Resist oppression through nonviolent means, maintaining moral legitimacy while seeking change.
whenWorks: When moral legitimacy and public visibility matter, and the opponent values reputation.
whenFails: Against actors who ignore moral pressure or use overwhelming force.

name: Nonviolent Direct Action
description: Create constructive nonviolent tension to force negotiation and change.
whenWorks: When seeking to expose injustice and force moral reckoning.
whenFails: When opponents are indifferent to moral pressure.
notes: Emphasizes creating crisis that forces negotiation.

name: Transactional Negotiation
description: Use leverage, unpredictability, and maximum pressure to extract concessions.
whenWorks: When you have asymmetric leverage and can absorb losses.
whenFails: Against principled opponents who walk away from bad deals.
notes: Prioritizes winning over relationship or principle.

name: Strategic Deception
description: Appear weak when you are strong, and strong when you are weak.
whenWorks: In competitive environments where information asymmetry matters.
whenFails: When trust is essential for long-term cooperation.

name: Stoic Acceptance
description: Accept what you cannot control, focus on what you can.
whenWorks: When facing circumstances beyond your control.
whenFails: When action is possible and necessary.

name: Will to Power
description: Assert your will and overcome constraints through strength.
whenWorks: When building something new requires breaking old structures.
whenFails: When collaboration and stability are needed.
notes: Embraces conflict as necessary for growth.

name: Harmonious Order
description: Maintain social harmony through respect for hierarchy and relationships.
whenWorks: In stable societies where relationships matter more than efficiency.
whenFails: When rapid innovation or individual rights are prioritized.

name: Political Realism
description: Do what is necessary to maintain power and achieve goals.
whenWorks: In high-stakes political environments where survival is at stake.
whenFails: When moral legitimacy and trust are essential.
